about: 零件数据里的中文（材料名、组件库的工况说明、配合规则表的原因、示范企业名、型号里的轴端代码）的英文；数据本身不改。测试核对材料库里每个中文名都有英文。

names.D 形孔一侧为平面，圆轴无法装入: a D-shaped bore has a flat side; a round shaft cannot go in
names.D 形轴与键槽孔形状不匹配: a D-shaped shaft does not match a keyed bore
names.D 形轴装入圆孔：接触面减少，需确认紧固方式能传递扭矩: D-shaped shaft in a round bore: less contact; confirm the fastening can carry the torque
names.光轴没有键槽，无法与键槽孔形成键连接: a plain shaft has no keyway and cannot form a key joint with a keyed bore
names.夹紧在 D 形平面上，夹紧力分布不均: clamping on the D flat spreads the clamping force unevenly
names.带键轴装入光孔：需拆除键，扭矩由夹紧或过盈传递: keyed shaft in a plain bore: remove the key; torque is carried by clamping or interference
names.紧定螺钉直接压在圆轴上，传扭能力有限: a set screw pressing directly on a round shaft carries little torque
names.花键只能与花键配合: a spline only mates with a spline
names.花键齿形规格 V1 未建模，需人工确认: spline tooth form is not modelled in V1; needs manual confirmation
names.键宽须相等（另行检查）: key widths must be equal (checked separately)
names.键槽轴与 D 形孔形状不匹配: a keyed shaft does not match a D-shaped bore
names.键连接要求轴和孔都有键槽: a key joint needs keyways in both shaft and bore
names.非圆截面过盈配合不常见，需人工确认: interference fits on non-round sections are unusual; needs manual confirmation
names.须为过盈或过渡配合（见配合表）: must be an interference or transition fit (see the fit table)
names.外形图：止口为法兰面上的凸台: outline drawing: the pilot is a boss on the flange face
names.折算到减速器输入侧（样本第 12 页定义）: referred to the reducer input (as defined on catalogue p. 12)
names.无制动器，编码器代码 7（Approx. Mass，括号内为带制动器）: without brake, encoder code 7 (Approx. Mass; values in brackets are with brake)
names.样本参考值（平均值），最小值约为表值的 80 %: catalogue reference value (average); the minimum is about 80 % of the table value
names.样本参考值，最小值约为表值的 80 %: catalogue reference value; the minimum is about 80 % of the table value
names.法兰止口（图中 LB dia.，凸出法兰面 LE）: flange pilot (LB dia. in the drawing, protruding LE from the flange face)
names.波发生器轴承 L10，额定扭矩、额定输入转速: wave generator bearing L10, rated torque, rated input speed
names.编码器代码 7（24-bit absolute），外形尺寸主表适用（ADR-00: encoder code 7 (24-bit absolute); the main outline table applies (ADR-0044 item 3, added 2026-10-05)
names.脂润滑（Grease），开式与防尘盖（Open、Z、ZZ、V、VV）: grease lubrication, open and shielded (Open, Z, ZZ, V, VV)
names.轴端代码 6（Straight with key and tap）: shaft end code 6 (straight with key and tap)
names.轴端代码 6（Straight with key and tap），02、04、: shaft end code 6 (straight with key and tap); one row for 02, 04, 06
names.额定扭矩、脂润滑（目录第 134 页表 134-1 测量条件）；网格温度读点，向: rated torque, grease lubrication (measurement conditions of table 134-1 on catalogue p. 134); read at the grid temperature, rounded down to 1%
